text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Bournemouth and Chelsea at the Vitality Stadium!

After opening the season with a draw against Liverpool and a loss to West Ham, Chelsea's time under Mauricio Pochettino looked to be turning around as they beat Luton Town in the Premier League and scraped past AFC Wimbledon in the EFL Cup.
However, they went into the international break on the back of a shock 1-0 defeat to Nottingham Forest.
As for Bournemouth, they got their first win under Andoni Iraola in the EFL Cup when they knocked out Swansea City, but they're still waiting for their first league victory under him.
They've drawn two and lost two, and were denied three points by a late Brentford equaliser last time out.
Iraola makes three changes to the side that started against Brentford two weeks ago.
Ouattara returns from an ankle injury to start, with Kelly and Tavernier also coming in.
Senesi, Semenyo and Kluivert all drop to the bench.
Pochettino makes just two changes from their defeat to Forest last time out, as Ugochukwu and Mudryk are both brought into the side.
Chilwell starts on an inexperienced bench, while Moises Caicedo isn't in the squad after being away with Ecuador during the international break.

Bournemouth have only won more Premier League games against Leicester City and Everton (both five) than they have against Chelsea (four), though three of those four victories against the Blues have been at Stamford Bridge.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Christie gets the game underway for Bournemouth!
Gusto slips and loses the ball, but quickly recovers to win it back.
He sends it forward for Sterling, who lays it off to Fernandez on the edge of the D, but his low shot is straight at Neto.
GOOD CHANCE! Mudryk's throughball to Jackson is cut out, but the forward steps in to win it back and pick out the Ukrainian again.
He drives to the byline before pulling it back to Gallagher, but his first-time shot is blocked at the near post.
Solanke is surging forward on the counter and Sterling slides in to cynically bring him down.
He picks up an early yellow card.
Kerkez finds some space down the right and he looks to squeeze a pass into Solanke, who is between two defenders.
Disasi intercepts it, and there are half-hearted handball shouts from the crowd, but nothing's given.
It's better from Bournemouth here as Cook breezes past Gusto on the left and fizzes a low cross into the middle.
Ouattara chooses to let it run and Disasi stops it from reaching Solanke.
Chelsea did the Premier League double over Bournemouth last season (2-0 at home, 3-1 away), having won just one of their previous five against the Cherries (D1 L3).
Gallagher cuts inside from the right before playing a lovely reverse pass through to Sterling in space.
It looked like he was going to shoot, but he drags it along the edge of the six-yard box, and none of the Chelsea players get a touch.
OFF THE POST! Mudryk plays a one-two with Jackson on the left, before deciding against having a run and teeing up the forward for a shot.
He takes it from the edge of the box and it bounces off the bottom of the near post, much to Neto's relief.
Chelsea are still dominating possession here, and Bournemouth just can't get close to them.
They're trying to press high upfield, but it's not deterring Chelsea from their patient play.
Mudryk wins a corner, which he then takes short, playing a one-two with Ugochukwu before swinging in a cross.
It takes a big deflection off Christie which has Neto scrambling, but it lands on the roof of the net.
GREAT SAVE! Bournemouth win a free-kick on the right which is taken quickly to Christie as he darts into the box.
He fizzes it to the far post where Ouattara has a free run, but Sanchez gets down to smother his first-time shot.
Bournemouth are growing into the game now, and their pressure is starting to cause Chelsea some problems.
Jackson drops deep to get on the ball, only to be dispossessed by Tavernier, who then wins another free-kick.
Sterling makes a brilliant run down the right, but can't pick out a team-mate with his cross.
Chelsea keep it alive through Gusto though as he fires a cross at Jackson.
His first touch is poor, but he still manages a volley on goal, which Kelly blocks.
Bournemouth work it quickly upfield after winning a free-kick on the edge of their own box, but their passing in the final third is letting them down.
Tavernier tries to pick out Solanke, only to see it blocked by Silva.

text: Aarons loops a cross in from the right this time, and Billing stretches high to bring it down with a good first touch.
Chelsea defenders quickly swarm around him though, and he loses it before he can have a shot.
Bournemouth switch it neatly from right to left as they try to open up some space in behind Chelsea.
Kerkez fires a powerful cross at Christie from close range, and it bounces off him to Disasi, who gratefully hooks it clear.
Again, Bournemouth find space down the right, and Christie cuts inside before deciding to have a go himself.
His low shot is drilled straight at Colwill though, and Solanke can't latch onto the loose ball.
Billing rolls awkwardly on his ankle as he tries to block Colwill's clearance and he stays down on the sideline in need of treatment.
He's moving gingerly when he gets back to his feet, but he's going to carry on.
GOOD SAVE! It's more good work from Mudryk down the left as he flashes a cross between two Bournemouth players to pick out Gallagher.
He gets it out of his feet before poking a shot on goal, but Neto reacts quickly to push it away.
Bournemouth sit back and allow Silva to carry the ball a long way upfield.
When nobody closes him down, he decides to loop an early cross into the box, but it's too close to Neto.
Chelsea are back to keeping possession in their own half at the moment.
They're trying to break up the rhythm that Bournemouth were building, and are patiently playing out from the back.
Chelsea win a free-kick on the halfway line and it's played short to Fernandez, who drives down the right before squaring it to Sterling.
He skips past two before moving into the box, but Zabarnyi stops him in his tracks.
Mudryk's first touch is heavy and he takes out Aarons as he tries to keep it alive.
He goes into the referee's book.
Chelsea win another free-kick in midfield, which Gusto takes quickly to Sterling.
Kerkez sticks tight to him down the right though, and doesn't give him any space to pick out a cross.
The visitors are looking to finish this half on a high.
They're keeping Bournemouth penned back deep in their own half as they try to find an opening, but there's no way through at the moment.
HALF-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 0-0 CHELSEA.
It's goalless at the break between Bournemouth and Chelsea.
Both sides created some good chances in the first half, with Jackson striking the bottom of the post and Gallagher forcing a good reflex save out of Neto for the visitors.
It took Bournemouth a while to grow into the game, but their best chance was actually the first one they created, with Ouattara seeing a shot smothered by Sanchez at the far post.
In some ways, it's the same old problem for Chelsea.
They're playing well and getting into good positions, but they're just lacking that clinical edge in front of goal, which is something Pochettino will be asking them to improve on.
Despite a slow start, Bournemouth have done well, and do look like they can cause Chelsea some problems when they do get forward.
Chelsea get us back under way for the second half!
It's Chelsea with all of the early possession in the second half, and Colwill sends it down the left for Fernandez to chase.
He knocks it past Aarons, but can't get around the defender himself.
NO GOAL! Sterling steps up to take a free-kick right outside the box, and he curls it to the far top corner.
It rattles the underside of the crossbar and bounces off the line and back out to Colwill.
He slots in from close range, but the flag goes up to deny him a first Chelsea goal.
Bournemouth commit a lot of bodies forward in attack, which allows Chelsea to quickly counter.
Colwill carries it to the edge of the box before squaring it to Jackson, but Billing sticks out a leg to stop it from reaching him.
Again, Chelsea surge forward on the break and Ugochukwu slides it through to Jackson on the left of the box.
He loses his bearings for a moment and slices a shot well wide of the near post.
It's well worked in a tight spot by Bournemouth, and Kerkez does well to keep it in play as he pulls it back from the byline.
He can't pick out a team-mate in the middle though.
WIDE! Chelsea are all over the place at the back as Bournemouth up the pressure, and Kerkez drills a dangerous low cross into the box.
It misses Solanke, and Silva puts his foot through a clearance that hits Tavernier and rolls just wide of the post.
Gusto got in a tangle with Christie before that last Bournemouth chance, and he stayed down holding his calf as it played out.
He now receives treatment, and he'll be able to carry on.
Chelsea are back to keeping possession as they patiently try to pass their way upfield.
Bournemouth are sticking tight to them and making it difficult.
Kerkez has his arms around Sterling as he tries to stop him from spinning in behind.
They go down in a tangle, and the left-back is booked for the challenge.
Both sides are making a change here, starting with Chelsea.
Mudryk is taken off, with Palmer on for him.
And for Bournemouth, Ouattara makes way for Kluivert.
SAVE! Bournemouth can't clear their lines from a corner and it's slotted through to Jackson at the far post.
He pokes it towards goal, and Neto fumbles to save, but reacts quickly to stop Gallagher from getting a tap-in.
Christie does brilliantly to spin away from trouble and, after getting his head up, threads it forward for Kluivert to chase.
Sanchez was alert to the danger though, and rushes out of his box to hook it away.
Bournemouth have everybody sitting deep in and around their box as Chelsea push forward again.
Gusto finds himself with space through the middle and tries his luck from a long way out, curling it high and wide of the top corner.
Bournemouth are starting to push forward with a bit more intent now and Kluivert is causing problems down the left.
He's tripped by Gusto to win a free-kick, but nothing comes of it.
Kerkez, who is on a booking, also goes off for Senesi.
Bournemouth are making a double change.
Tavernier is the first to go off, and Sinisterra is on in his place as he makes his debut for the Cherries.
Kluivert makes another darting run towards the box, and Disasi slides in and kicks his legs out from under him.
He gets a yellow card, and Bournemouth have a free-kick in the D.
BLOCK! Billing had to wait a while to take the free-kick due to some pushing in the box.
When he does strike it, he fizzes it low towards the far bottom corner, but a deflection off Gallagher takes it out for a corner.
GOOD SAVE! It looks too easy for Bournemouth as Billing squares a low cross in from the left, and Solanke's first touch knocks it past Gallagher, wrongfooting the midfielder.
He takes on the shot, but Sanchez gets behind it.
Chelsea are making a double change now.
Colwill is the first to go off, with Chilwell on for him.
Jackson is booked for dissent.
And Fernandez takes his time leaving the field as Maatsen comes on in his place.
CHANCE! Chilwell takes a corner which is blocked and deflects straight back to him.
On the second try, he picks out Jackson in the middle, but he doesn't get enough on his header, and Neto shuffles across to save it.
GREAT SAVE! It's lovely play from Chelsea as they knock it upfield with a series of one-touch passes.
Sterling pulls it back from the byline and Palmer instinctively sticks out a leg to meet it.
Neto gets a strong right hand to it.
The game is wide open as both teams go for a late winner here.
Billing bursts forward down the left this time and unselfishly lifts it into the middle.
Solanke can only get a glancing touch off his head, and it sails wide.
The hosts' final change sees Brooks come on for Christie.
Into the first of eight added minutes here, and Chelsea are racing forward on the counter.
It slows down when it gets to Sterling, and the visitors try to pass it into space, allowing Bournemouth to get back into their shape.
There's a nervy moment as it's passed back to Sanchez, and he holds onto it, trying to direct his team-mates to where he wants them.
He sees Solanke's pressing run just in time to clear his lines.
Bournemouth are threatening to counter, and Chilwell clips Kluivert to stop that from happening.
He picks up a late yellow card.
Chilwell takes a corner short to Sterling before getting it back and clipping it in from the byline.
He's looking for Maatsen on the penalty spot, but it's just too high for the Dutchman.
FULL-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 0-0 CHELSEA.
It finishes goalless between Bournemouth and Chelsea.
The Blues hit the woodwork twice, with Jackson striking the bottom of the post in the first half before Sterling struck the underside of the crossbar with a lovely free-kick just after the break.
Colwill was alert to poke the rebound of that set-piece in from close range, but the offside flag denied him a first Chelsea goal.
Neto and Sanchez were both called upon to make big saves in both halves, and neither team could find a way to break the deadlock.
Chelsea's stuttering start to the season continues as they stay in 14th, and next up for them is Aston Villa at home.
As for Bournemouth, they move up to 15th as their wait for a first Premier League win under Iraola continues.
They travel to Brighton and Hove Albion next weekend.
That's all for today, goodbye!
